pages.text: $(bold)Description:$() The Observer Core sits on the central pedestal of the Throne. It is the remains of the previous observer and the socket of the observer array. It has been lit the whole time; it is only that no one has been connected to it.

$(bold)Installation procedure:$()$(br2)$(li)1. Complete an OBSR-3;$(br)$(li)2. hold that model and right-click the Observer Core to open the core interface;$(br)$(li)3. choose "Install Candidate Observer".$(br2)Installation consumes the model.

$(bold)Effect:$() after installation the core begins to refocus, which takes a short time to complete.$(br2)At the moment of completion:$(br)$(li)the core lights;$(br)$(li)the observer array accepts a new observer;$(br)$(li)defocus terminates.$(br2)From then on blocks no longer drift, creatures are no longer replaced, and the weather no longer mutates.

$(bold)Aftermath:$() Termination is not repair. What has already drifted will not come back; there is no restoration recipe and no rollback. The world will stop in the state it was in at the moment you completed it.

$(italic)The last thing that happened in the previous iteration was this:$(br2)its final two executors each had a line to pull, and neither line was within their stabilisation parameters.$(br2)Both of them knew they would not see the dawn.
